reply:
For sautéing vegetables, use medium-high to high heat. You want the pan hot enough to get a nice sear without burning, but not so hot that everything smokes. A good test: add your oil and it should shimmer immediately—that's the signal to add your veggies.

The key is also not to overcrowd the pan. If you pile too many vegetables in, they'll steam instead of sauté, which is why they turn soggy. Work in small batches if needed.
